title: Critical Minerals Watch Capsule
description: A compact market-watch fixture for testing whether investment-style highlights work as reader, mobile feed, slides, and reel surfaces.

sections.title: Watch thesis
sections.body: The artifact tracks early-stage critical minerals themes where land position, permitting path, infrastructure, and technical evidence matter more than promotional claims.

sections.title: Signals to monitor
sections.body: Look for drill-ready targets, coherent geophysical signatures, credible sampling, nearby infrastructure, aligned management incentives, and repeatable disclosure quality.

sections.title: Risk frame
sections.body: The main risks are dilution, weak field execution, unclear metallurgy, inaccessible terrain, over-promoted analogies, and limited capital-market attention.

sections.title: Vault workflow
sections.body: Each new company capsule should preserve the original source bytes, extract plain text, attach tags, and link siblings by project, commodity, region, and source registry.

sections.title: Decision use
sections.body: Use the capsule as a watchlist memory object, not as a buy signal. It should make follow-up questions clearer and keep provenance visible.

assets.alt: Four presentation surfaces derived from one Capsule data model.

cards.title: Critical Minerals
cards.body: A watch capsule should summarize the signal without pretending to be a recommendation.

cards.title: Look for signals
cards.body: Targets, infrastructure, sampling, management, and disclosure quality all belong in the same memory object.

cards.title: Name the risk
cards.body: Dilution, execution, metallurgy, terrain, hype, and attention risk should stay visible.

cards.title: Make it linkable
cards.body: Vault can connect sibling capsules by project, commodity, region, source, and registry.

cards.title: Memory, not advice
cards.body: The capsule helps you remember and compare. It does not replace judgment.
